entries.title: Removes deprecated Payment Intents, Setup Intents, and Sources methods from Stripe.js
entries.quote: Removes several deprecated methods from Stripe.js in favor of equivalent methods with clearer naming and improved functionality. The following methods have been removed and will throw an error if called: Payment Intents API: handleCardPayment, confirmPaymentIntent, handleFpxPayment; Setup Intents API: handleCardSetup, confirmSetupIntent; Sources API: createSource, retrieveSource.
